title.ur: Bahar wala DC fan motor kharab hai

meaning.en: Outdoor DC fan motor failed to run correctly or gave bad feedback.
meaning.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor theek se nahi chala ya usne ghalat feedback diya.

causes.ur: Fan motor ya wiring fail ho gayi
Fan scroll mein koi rukawat hai

solutions.en: Isolate supply and clear anything caught in the outdoor fan scroll, then check motor wiring for looseness
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke outdoor fan scroll mein phansi koi cheez hatayein, phir motor wiring ki tightness check karein

solutions.en: Test the motor with a meter and replace the outdoor DC fan motor if it does not run
solutions.ur: Motor ko meter se test karein aur chal na raha ho to outdoor DC fan motor badlein

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ acguide Lc/Ld casing)

meaning.en: Drive attempted compressor start but failed within allowed attempts.
meaning.ur: Drive ne compressor chalane ki koshish ki magar mehnat ke andar start nahi hua.

causes.ur: Power supply ya board ka masla hai

solutions.en: Power off, then verify the supply and the control board before another start attempt
solutions.ur: Power band karke, dobara start se pehle supply aur control board verify karein

solutions.en: A technician inspects the compressor for seizure with a meter and repairs or replaces it if it will not crank
solutions.ur: Technician meter se compressor ka seizure check kare aur chal na raha ho to repair ya replace kare

title.ur: Phase ghaib hone par compressor band

meaning.en: One power phase missing (3-phase units) → compressor stopped.
meaning.ur: 3-phase units mein se koi ek phase ghaib hai, is liye compressor band ho gaya.

causes.ur: Supply mein se ek phase gayab hai / wiring mein masla hai

solutions.en: Disconnect the unit and check all incoming phases at the supply terminals with a meter
solutions.ur: Unit disconnect karke meter se supply terminals par aane wale saare phases check karein

solutions.en: Restore the missing phase or repair the wiring and contactors, then restart the unit
solutions.ur: Gayab phase wapas layein ya wiring aur contactors theek karein, phir unit start karein

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK (+ acguide Lc/Ld casing)

notes.en: More relevant on 3-phase / large floor-standing or VRF. Per-code attribution: multi-pk.
notes.ur: Yeh zyada tar 3-phase, bade floor-standing ya VRF units par laagu hota hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk.

title.ur: Compressor rotor jam hone ki hifazat

meaning.en: Rotor failed to turn (seized or blocked) during start/run attempt.
meaning.ur: Chalane ya chalte rehne ki koshish ke dauran rotor pher hi nahi paya (jam ho gaya ya block tha).

causes.en: Broken starting components / prolonged single-phasing history
causes.ur: Starting components toot gaye / lambe arse se single-phasing chal rahi hai

solutions.en: Stop trying to start and isolate power; a seized rotor can burn the motor if it is forced
solutions.ur: Start karna band karein aur power isolate karein; rotor jam ho to zor lagane par motor jal sakta hai

solutions.en: See the manual or service centre, where a technician frees or replaces the compressor motor
solutions.ur: Manual dekhein ya service centre jayein, jahan technician compressor motor khudgaar kare ya badle
